title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Ledger Reconciliation: Card Payments Counted Against a Copay Card Benefit Load
content:
**Rule.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, a card program year runs from January 1 to December 31 of the program year named on its benefit load. The card payments taken off the latest benefit load are fixed by where today falls:

- When today falls within the latest load's program year, the card payments taken off the load are those dated fewer whole months before today than the first day of that program year.
- When the latest load's program year ended no more than 365 days before today, they are the card payments dated no more whole months before today than the load itself.
- Otherwise they are the card payments of the last 12 months, meaning those dated fewer than 12 whole months before today.

**Definitions.**

- **Card payments** are the copay card assistance applications on the enrollment's ledger, each dated by its entry date.
- **The load itself** is dated by the entry date of the latest benefit load.
- **Whole months.** The number of whole months between a date and today is the count of calendar months from that date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day of the month.

## Questions and answers

**Which window applies when today is inside the program year?** The first. Assume today is 2026-10-08 and the latest load is for program year 2026. The first day of the program year, 2026-01-01, lies 9 whole months before today, so card payments dated fewer than 9 whole months before today are counted.

| Card payment dated | Whole months before today | Counted? |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-15 | 0 | Yes |
| 2026-01-15 | 8 | Yes |
| 2026-01-05 | 9 | No, because 9 is not fewer than 9 |

**And when the program year has just ended?** The second, as long as the year ended no more than 365 days before today. Assume a load for program year 2026 entered on 2026-02-14, and today is 2027-03-10. The load lies 12 whole months before today, so card payments dated 12 or fewer whole months before today are counted.

| Card payment dated | Whole months before today | Counted? |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-02-20 | 12 | Yes |
| 2026-02-05 | 13 | No |

**Where is the 365-day line?** For a program year ending 2026-12-31, a today of 2027-12-31 is 365 days later and still falls under the second window. A today of 2028-01-01 is 366 days later and falls under the last.

**What if there is no load, or today is before the load's program year begins?** Neither of the first two windows applies, so the card payments of the last 12 months are counted.
